verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a hardware processor, not a software service or app that collects usage data, so a user-facing telemetry opt-out is outside its product category. The evidence pack does not show the chip itself shipping any telemetry or opt-out control. On-device AI claims ('AI software running locally') concern where inference runs, not telemetry opt-out, so they are not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
